set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q01
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend engineer with scientist and operator

Outcome: A published supported envelope describes measured capacity and correct behavior on representative institutional data.

Acceptance:
- Use named permitted collections and independent expected results for import, curation, query, exact historical export and accounting; honor source/scientific support boundaries.
- Measure realistic grants, concurrent readers/imports, large files, many files, revision growth, memory, latency and throughput; qualify pagination and the existing 10000-entry ceiling before enlarging it.
- Retain workload/hardware/source identities and raw results; explicitly resolve applicable PRD targets or approved narrower beta scope rather than treating small fixture timings as an SLA.

Evidence anchors:
- docs/evidence/query-scale-summary.json
- docs/prd.md
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: Q01: Qualify representative data and the institutional capacity envelope
